clips.title: The story
paras: In Ratchet, Mebok Mizzyrix keeps Snufflenose Owner's Manual beside him. Marwig Rustbolt of Snuff Inc. wrote the booklet to explain how to send a trained Snufflenose Gopher after Blueleaf Tubers in Razorfen Kraul.

Marwig Rustbolt, owner of Snuff Inc., wrote a guide to handling the company's trained snufflenose gophers. Their keen noses can detect Blueleaf Tubers buried underground from fifty paces away. The manual explains how to release a gopher from a ventilated crate and guide its rooting with a command stick. Prospectors direct it through Razorfen Kraul's thorns and quilboar tunnels to find the tubers.
